description: This file defines the build configuration, dependencies, installation steps, and service setup for the nginx web server within a Yocto build environment.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the nginx build with appropriate flags based on system architecture and environment variables.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs nginx, sets up configuration files, service scripts, and necessary directories.

methods.name: pkg_postinst:${PN}
methods.description: Post-installation script to create temporary files and directories for systemd or init.d.
